name: Klockmort's Creation
summary: In Tinker Town, Klockmort Spannerspan puts Furen Longbeard's forging method to work on rare materials. The result is armor made to endure.

sections.title: A Fusion of Disciplines
sections.body: Using Furen Longbeard's methods, Klockmort finishes a pair of armored gauntlets in Tinker Town. Dwarven metalworking and gnomish mechanical skill come together in gauntlets built to endure punishment that would crush ordinary steel.

sections.title: Unrivaled Resilience
sections.body: Klockmort says a siege engine could run over the armor without leaving lasting distortion. Peculiarly treated rare components give it resilience. Dwarven forging and gnomish ingenuity join in armor built to withstand the fiercest frontline battles.

faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan is a skilled gnome blacksmith in Tinker Town, Ironforge. He lends his hand to intricate mechanical work and joins dwarven craftsmen such as Furen Longbeard to make unusual, durable gear.

faq.q: Who designed the process to make this armor?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard, an accomplished dwarven armorsmith, devised the forging process. Klockmort followed Furen's exact methods to treat the materials and finish the armor.

faq.q: Why did a gnome blacksmith make this armor?
faq.answer: Klockmort wanted to try Furen Longbeard's new technique on armor of his own. Since you had helped Furen, Klockmort offered you the finished armor in return for gathering the searing coral he needed.

faq.q: What makes this armor special compared to standard plate?
faq.answer: Klockmort says the finished armor combines remarkable spring and elasticity with rigid durability. He claims that even if a heavy siege engine flattened it, the metal would snap back into its original shape.

faq.q: Where does this armor fit in the path of a warrior's training?
faq.answer: The armor belongs to a series of tasks for promising Alliance warriors seeking resilient gear custom-forged by Ironforge's finest minds.
Klockmort Spannerspan works among the workshops, clanking gears, and steam vents of Tinker Town, Ironforge's gnomish quarter.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you reach an important milestone with these gauntlets, custom-tempered to endure the crushing blows of frontline combat.
As a gnome, you see how your people's ingenuity aids heavy armor making, joining mechanical precision with dwarven craft.
As a blacksmith, you see the value of testing unconventional tempering methods with rare materials from the sea.
